text: The cornflour is stirred smooth in a little cold milk, then into the hot sweetened milk. Boiling gelatinises the starch, which then sets to a gel as it cools. Home recipes differ a lot in proportions; Wikipedia gives no numbers.

steps.note: Bay leaf or lemon peel in the hot milk.
2 tablespoons, mixed with 1/4 cup of the cold milk first.
Brought to the boil, then simmered.

steps.name: set
steps.note: In a mould rinsed with cold water, chilled until set.
